sql: UPDATE assets SET is_flight_asset = 1 WHERE id = {asset}

INSERT INTO flights (cfi_id, student_id, asset_id, flight_date, hobbs_start, started_at, scheduled_flight_id, late_minutes, late_note, eta_at) VALUES ({cfi}, {student}, {asset}, date('now','localtime'), 100.0, datetime('now','localtime','-30 minutes'), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM scheduled_flights), 25, 'Headwind on the way back', datetime('now','localtime','+25 minutes'))
